basic_info.description: This rarely available, renovated private top floor 3BR/2BA condo in a desirable two-unit building is located in the heart of the highly coveted and convenient Lower Pacific Heights neighborhood. Measuring a generous 1,615 square feet, the home features views, an abundance of natural light and soaring high ceilings throughout. The versatile floor plan with the dining room and family room adjacent to the kitchen is designed for entertaining and comfortable family living. The designer gourmet kitchen has been extensively remodeled with multiple skylights, breakfast bar, Calacatta marble countertops and backsplash, high-end luxury stainless steel appliances such as Subzero refrigerator, Wolf gas range, multiple wine fridges, and ample cabinet space. Enjoy the large, beautiful shared sunny backyard and garden for barbequing, hosting guests, or relaxing outdoors. The well-cared for building had a new roof installed recently and the exterior was freshly painted. Other highlights include wood floors throughout, walk-in pantry, in-unit washer/dryer, one car garage parking plus private storage. With a Walk Score of 95 and located near public transit, the JCC, and blocks from vibrant Fillmore Street, this home is ideal for those seeking the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience.
